chunks: From him, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿĪsā, from Ibn Muskān, from Abī Bakr al-Ḥaḍramī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in a man wiping his face with a cloth when he performs wudu (ablution), if the cloth is clean.

key_terms.بِمَسْحِ: with wiping; the act of drying or wiping
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression indicating permissibility
key_terms.نَظِيفًا: clean; free from impurity or dirt

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to wipe the face with a cloth after wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to wudu (ablution), stating that wiping the face with a cloth after performing wudu (ablution) is permissible. The condition mentioned is that the cloth must be clean, indicating attention to ritual purity and cleanliness.
